reviews.text:
The staff is very knowledgeable and friendly. No one works there just to have a job. It is very evident that they are all there because of their love for and desire to care for animals.
Every vet is professional, kind and well qualified. Dr. Ferguson though,  is an angel.
Experience, professionalism, compassion, and empathy -- we are so grateful to have found Four-Legged Friends.
They are amazing the love & medical care given to the dogs
The absolute best! We drive from the far northwest valley to see Dr Furgeson. The staff loves our 14 yr old boy and they never pressure for tests or unwanted procedures.
Four-Legged Friends is the best - the care is exceptional!
We’ve been going to Four Legged Friends for close to 30 years & totally trust Dr. Ferguson & staff 100%%
The doctors are wonderful and the staff are very friendly.

Dr. Ferguson and all the staff are all amazing! They have taken amazing care of our pets for over 25 years!  They truly care about their patients and families that trust them with their beloved pets! We love them!!
Dr. Isom and staff are great. Very friendly and helpful getting my doggie better.
Dr. Ferguson and her staff are awesome!
this vet is always super nice & knowledgeable, sometimes hard to get appointments, not the cheapest but one of the best.
You all were so caring and helpful.  You kept me informed!  Missy seemed more relaxed....and you had to do so much with her.
All of my pets that include 3 large, rescued dogs and an elderly cat that used to be my father's receive their care at 4 Legged Friends. The staff and vets' expertise and compassion is amazing.
Extremely caring and thoughtful with Buddy condition. Great communication skills. Glad had recommendations from Lauren Rodger’s.
The atmosphere is positive, calm and comfortable. Everyone is helpful in their own way and I enjoyed being addressed by my first name because I feel like family.

Great experience with Dr Ferguson, as always!  The front desk staff are all cordial and knowledgeable.  The vet tech was so helpful and caring with my dog.  I appreciate the staff of Four-Legged Friends Animal Hospital!

Dr. Ferguson and her team have been our family's vet for 15 yrs. They've tended to 6 of our family dogs. The front office staff is nice, communicative and efficient. Jaime, Lynn, Ashley, Brittany and Brynn get a special shout out from us.

Love Four Legged Friends!

Have been going here for over 30 years. All my friends do also. Great vets, wonderful office staff.
Always helpful. Everything was explained fully so I understand what to do at home.
Love the doctors here.  Very professional and knowledgeable.
Staff is on time, courteous, great care for our pet.  DR Ferguson is absolutely the best Vet and human being ever!!!  If only human health was this great of experience.   Thank you!
Thank you for getting me in and a quick turn around
I was very pleased with the personnel at Four-Legged Friends!  I highly recommend them as your trusted vet clinic!
Valley fever treatment for my dog

We have been seeing Dr. Bessemer since our lab was a puppy. She will be 13 years old this year and he is compassionate and very knowledgeable. He always recommends the conservative size of treatment first which we love. He is the only Vet we trust. You will not go wrong with Four-Legged Friends and Dr. Bessemer.

Dr. Riddle is amazing in taking care of my cat. She is excellent at diagnosing and creating a treatment plan that is successful. My cat has had some health issues this past year and thanks to Dr. Riddle she is doing great. The entire staff is caring and very professional and supportive. I highly recommend them.
Excellent care and attention !
Always friendly and thorough with my pups visits.  I’ve been going to FLF for 25 years so that should tell you how I feel!
I have always had excellent service at Four Legged Friends Animal Hospital.  Today I had to put my Teddy down and the compassion shown was exceptional.   Thanks to all the staff
Thank you for your 5-star rating, Rod!
Thank you for your 5-star rating, Rosemary!
I have been with Four legged friends for a very long time and now live about 30 minutes away but I have still stayed with them as they are the best.

The staff is always so supportive and patient. I’ve rescued a dog that was severely abused and she has serious behavioral issues.
I’m so grateful to have found Four Legged Friends because other vets have refused us care and these folks have been amazing.

Dr. Riddle and the team at Four Legged Friends are fantastic! They took incredible care of our pets at their annual checkup and is making a huge difference in ensuring they’re happy and healthy. We really appreciate how thorough they are and how much effort went into keeping our pets calm and comfortable the entire time they were there.

Dr. Ferguson and Pam are an absolutely incredible team. From the moment we started going there over 8 years ago everyone has been warm, caring, and genuinely compassionate. The staff takes the time to listen, explain everything clearly, and made sure we and our dogs feel comfortable and cared for. It’s clear that Dr.  Ferguson,  Pam and the entire staff truly love what they do and treat every animal like family. I couldn’t be more grateful for the kindness, professionalism, and exceptional care we receive every visit. Highly recommend this practice to anyone looking for a trustworthy, knowledgeable, and compassionate team! ❤️🐾

I’ve been coming to Four Legged Friends for many years. Dr. Ferguson is by far the best veterinarian. She is kind, passionate, understanding and knows her medicine. She has helped us with all of our adopted senior dogs and has been by our side when we’ve had to say goodbye to our pups.
Her vet tech Pam is amazing. She loves our dogs as much as we do. We think of Dr. Ferguson, and all of the Four Legged Friends staff as family. They are by far the best at what they do and I highly recommend Four Legged Friends.

My family has been with Four legged friends for 25 years now. Multiple pets across the decades. Everyone is awesome and understands compassion along with professionalism!!!
My wife and I like all of the Vets and Techs!!!
Dr. Ferguson and Pam are my favorites.
Our Fur babies get the best care!!!
Thank you

DR. BESSMER is the best Dr ever! Over many years, he’s helped me when my kitties were sick, or when I had to say goodbye to them. He took very good care of Phinn To make him comfortable for the days he has left!
Amazing staff all around!
Took great care of Clarence and followed up with us to make sure he was still doing okay a few days later.
Dr Bessemer is amazing.  I also want to acknowledge Brittany, she helped get my cat in today as it was her time.  Best vet I’ve ever had. Thank you Brittany for your kindness today
This was my first time bringing my cat here. My cat absolutely loved the dr. Besemer.
Thank you for your 5-star rating Farooq.
Thank you for your 5-star rating Heather!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Very caring, answer all important issues and concerns you have for your beloved 4 legged pet. The best! All the staff are very nice.
Thank you for your positive rating Jeanna :)

Wonderful experience. They got my dog in quickly, and even my usually skittish pup felt completely at ease with the staff. They truly listened, explained everything clearly, and made the appointment feel prompt but never rushed. Excellent care all around.
Dr. Ferguson and her staff are the absolute best! They are always kind,  professional and genuinely care about our fur babies. ❤️
Very helpful and Dr. Fergeson was great.

Have trusted the care of our dogs & cats over many years to Dr Ferguson and staff.  They are amazing people that stay current on latest procedures & incredibly compassionate when our fur kids are either young, newly adopted and also  very old.
We've been coming to Four Legged Friends for more than 25 years!  We love all the doctors (especially Dr. Valerie Ferguson)  and staff!  Highly recommend!

Our dog was very apprehensive to go in the room at first . Everyone was very patient and good to her and said she did very well in the back room when drawing labs and cutting her nails. Very pleased with everyone's care. Thank you!
Dr. Ferguson and the office staff were amazing. I found myself a new vet.
They are quite simply the BEST!!!
Best vet ever first class.great staff.
As always Dr Isom and staff were terrific! They took such care of our little guy when he had his last few teeth left extracted.  Dr Isom is the best!

I love this vet clinic. Dr Riddle is honest about the prices and has never tried to sell me or push something on me that I didn’t need or couldn’t afford. I’ve had to put 2 dogs to sleep since finding her, both due to age and health related issues, she was so kind during that process. I just got a new puppy and he was sick one night in the emergency room. The clinic rearranged Dr Riddles schedule in order to get him in the day we got out of the ER, just to do a follow up on him. They called me a few days later to check on him. I there is another dr in the clinic I had and had to return to the clinic due to not getting the correct treatment for. Other than that incident, this clinic and Dr Riddle have been my go to since I found her after moving to this side of town!
Best vets and staff anywhere !!  Theo graduated from the puppy vaccination program and Milo was there for support and his heart worm test.

I have been a client of 4 Legged Friends for 20 years. Dr. Ferguson and her staff are amazing. We have been very happy with their services. They know us by face, and they are familiar with our dogs stories and records. Dr. Ferguson saved our first furbaby who had been misdiagnosed and changed medications and gave him a longer life with us, she saved another 4lb pup from parvo and treated many other oddities in our pack. The staff has taken care of all 9 of our dogs for two decades and we are eternally grateful. We love you all at 4 Legged Friends.

Kind, understanding, polite, informative. They do not push their meds. Had small surgery on my dog. They called next day to check on us. Been to 2 vets before I came to this one. One brought my dog back to me bleeding from nail clipping and the other gave me a hard time about not buying their Heartgard.

After my previous vet retired, I have searched through several offices for someone who truly cared and understood the needs of my extremely active working dogs.  I was referred to Four Legged Friends so I made an appointment and took my dogs in for an exam.  I was very impressed and pleased with the understanding of the demands put on my dogs in their daily life.
I have never been happier with the care my dogs receive.  The staff is professional and personable.  I highly recommend using Four Legged Friends for all of your pet needs.  You will not be disappointed.

I called to bring Bailey in for a puncture wound in his chest… They didn’t have an appointment available so they had me bring him and just leave him until one of the doctor had a chance to take a look at him.
The team is super accommodating and always nice and pleasant to work with
The most caring! Literally saved my dogs life many times. They all love going to see Dr. Ferguson, and all of her team!
Always enjoy everyone here. Great honest service.
Most amazing group! George, Winston, louie and PJ love you!

I absolutely love Four Legged Friends. After trying 3 different vets in the valley, this group is outstanding.  I have had many dogs over the past 30 years and most vets are perfectly fine for healthy routine check ups.  What differentiates a vet to me is how they are when something goes wrong.  And this group is amazing. Dr. Bessemer is who I usually see but have had experience with most of the staff. When my dog was attacked while walking by a loose dog and had serious puncture wounds that required constant care for a month, Dr. Bessemer was so caring and patient and was able to see us whenever something wasn’t healing as expected. The entire staff is so welcoming and good with my dog.  My dog is also getting those older dog fatty lumps and they guided me through my options, were transparent with all the costs and were able to confirm they were fatty tumors and not something more complex.  I tell everyone I meet to go to this veterinary clinic even if it’s a little bit of a drive. The care is worth it!!!

I recently changed over to 4LF because they were able to get my dog in when my vet couldn't and it was a serious condition. They really dialed in what was going on and were able to help him through. I love the special attention they give and don't try to talk you into anything you don't need.

Routine visit and the doc found a cancerous tumor. Staff was amazing at getting blood work and surgery scheduled quickly.

My many critters have visited all of the docs at one time or another and I cannot say enough how wonderful they all are. The support staff from the reception area to the techs in the back are all aces in what they do and the care they give my critters.

You can't go wrong with Four Legged Friends.
We have been taking our dogs to the wonderful vets at Four-legged Friends for almost 7 years. They are absolutely the best. The staff is fantastic too.
Always outstanding
staff always welcoming. we've had quality care. Only reason would consider 4 star is it can be challenging to get an appointment ...
The Dr. and staff very pleasant, they made our visit a positive experience.Thank you
I have taken five of my golden retrievers to Dr. Ferguson and her staff over the past 20 years.  The care and compassion given to my pups has always been superb!  I highly recommend this care team!!!

I have been going to this veterinary practice for approximately 20 years. The premises are clean and organized. The staff is always professional, friendly and respectful, and the doctors are awesome. They take the time to listen and address any questions or issues. I have never felt rushed like I do when I have to go to people doctors.
We had blood work done for an ongoing health issue with our Yorkie.

Been going to Four Legged Friends Animal Hospital for over 10 years.  The doctors, techs, and office staff are wonderful - friendly, efficient, and knowledgeable.  They always take whatever time needed to fully explain whatever issue my pets are having and suggest options.  Rio developed swelling under his jaw after his dental and they had me bring him in right away and worked him into the schedule.
Dr. Mike Besemer is the best!  He is a great conscientious doctor and treats my dog as if it were his own.  Highly recommend Dr. Besemer and Four Legged Friends Animal Hospital.
Dr Riddle was very kind and considerate in taking care of my kitty . She made it affordable but also made my kitty feel better ! !

Always the best care for our dog Jelly. He'll be 10 years old and has been through some rough spots in his life and everyone at Four Legged Friends is so professional and supportive making sure he gets the care he needs. Thank you Four Legged Friends!

I can’t say enough about how awesome 4 legged friends has been for my 100lb. big baby, Bubba. He has been going there for 4 yrs since he was just a little pup. All the staff have been great with him. He isn’t very social but that all melts away as soon as he knows that we are headed there. He even stands up on his hind legs with his front paws on the counter top so he can see everyone behind the desk and say hello. The doctors are amazing with him! I highly recommend 4 Legged Friends to anyone I talk pets with.

I love this place! The staff is very friendly and recognizes me every time i walk into the vet.  My vet Julia Harbo and I highly recommend her!!  They have a multi animal discount.  Harbo walks us through all the treatments and doesn't try to up-sale us on anything.  I highly recommend this place, i will never go anywhere else.
We LOVE this office and especially Dr. Besemer and the staff…Jamie, Dena, Pam, Brittney and Ashley. The best!!   They are wonderful and take such great care of our sweet Oliver!! Highly recommend.

What has happened to this place? I have been visiting for years, and during our most recent visit, the temporary veterinarian was very quick and seemed to simply run through a standard script of available services for our situation.

After we brought our cat home and administered the prescribed medication, she immediately started foaming at the mouth. We then waited on hold for 15 minutes before being told to expect a call back when the technician or veterinarian has a moment. We are concerned about our cat foaming at the mouth—should we take her to the emergency room? Is it safe to encourage her to drink water? Any guidance or reassurance would have been appreciated.

We have recommended this practice to many friends, family, and clients, but at this point, we feel the level of care provided has diminished. Unfortunately, Dr. Bolduc, who has always been preferred, is currently on leave, so we will need to reconsider our options.

This office needs to improve its standards of care.

Edit: the temp vet was still a bit brash, but we’ve gotten good help from the technician. Moving it up to 2 stars. I have to,give back one more star because of your great technician.

I've been going there well over 20 years and love the entire staff, even though Dr Ferguson is my favorite "go to" doctor. I trust my dogs with her with no hesitation, but doctors Isom, Besemer and Quandt have all been wonderful with my crew. It is impressive how very little the staff has changed over that long time. People stay for a good reason.

I love Dr. Val and Four-Legged Friends. I have been bringing my dogs there since 1998. I wish that I trusted my own doctor as much. The people are compassionate and helpful and take great care of our pets. The use of this new app to remind people to set up yearly appointments, schedule appointment times works really well. I downloaded the app, selected a time. I got a phone call to confirm my choice and then received a confirmation and then reminders about it. The app includes all the information about my dogs including vaccination history and medications.

They are always incredibly thorough, kind, and easy to communicate with. Been coming here for years, and continue to do so even though we moved quite a bit away. Dr. Riddle has been our most recent doc and she’s been great. Have also seen Dr. Ferguson who is equally great.

I have been going to this practice for years. I have Rottweilers, and they are often not a vet's favorite breed, but mine actually love the vet, and are always treated with respect. They are not only great people, but great vets, and have supported me through some pretty awful times, with several of my dogs. Everything was done with knowledge, kindness, compassion, and including me as a partner in their care. Always the best.
Great place to bring your pet! The staff cares and gives your fur kid all they need.
Friendly and knowledgeable staff.  Excellent Veterinarians.  My dog loves them.

Dr. Ferguson and the excellent team at Four Legged Friends is awesome. They have been taking care of us and our dogs for over 25 years. From new little puppies through some health issues to the end of life. Compassionate, caring, professionals all. I can’t recommend them enough.
This vet service is awesome. Their follow up is incredible like no other in any business I've ever dealt with. So friendly and caring by all employees.
I have been coming here for years and have always received the most amazing care. I love Dr Riddle and all the staff there
Wonderful doctors and staff!!  Highly recommend.
Very professional, caring and efficient!
Great employees and wonderful vets
Caring staff,  love our vet, dr Ferguson 💖
Best Vet services in the valley!
I would not take a beloved pet anywhere else!   The staff is wonderful as is DR Ferguson

We found Dr. Val through our local dog rescue about 20 years ago and she has been our vet ever since, whether dogs through the rescue or not. It's a drive from the West Valley, but so worth it with the excellent care our pups have received over the years.
Dr. Val, fellow Drs and her staff at Four Legged Friends have been our go to pet heath team for more than 25 years! They really are friendly, always helpful and very professional.
I've been going for years now. The staff is great and Dr. Isom is fantastic!

Dr Bessemer is excellent  - I’ve never seen a veterinarian perform such a thorough, hands-on exam on my dogs.  He never rushes, spends extra time on each part of his physical exam .
This is so important for animals, as they can’t communicate symptoms and we don’t order routine screening/imaging /tests like we do in humans.
Dr Besemer clearly loves animals and cares about  his patients .
The office staff is always extremely friendly and welcoming, personable, accommodating.
I highly recommend Four legged friends !
Love Dr. Besemer!
The staff was very friendly and very helpful

Our furry boy (and his 4 furry sisters before him) have always gotten exceptional care from everyone at 4 Legged Friends. Their office has expanded over the years, but their commitment to your family member's  health and best quality of life are what every family hopes for.

I can’t explain enough how wonderful Dr. Ferguson and everyone at the office is. They are the most kind, understanding, accommodating group. I am always in the office with my kids and they are helpful and don’t make me feel bad for the chaos. Their care for my dogs is amazing.
Very friendly staff.  We feel Dr. Ferguson is very knowledgeable & trust our new pup Rocky with her.
Helpful staff, clean surroundings, on first day our dog came home happy

I absolutely LOVE LOVE LOVE Four Legged Friends.  I have had five doggies under their care.  I would NOT go anywhere else.  They are compassionate, have an abundance of empathy and sympathy.  When I had to say goodbye to my little Abigail, they cried right along side of me.  Beautiful people!  Thank you Four Legged Friends for ALL of your support.  Ya'll are truly a blessing from above.
We always get great care.  All staff is very professional.
I very much enjoyed our first visit with Dr. Jennifer Ferguson, who I found through the Canine Valley Fever Project. Everyone has been helpful and super nice so far.
Dr Val and the staff are super compassionate, knowledgeable and supportive! Highly recommend!
The staff and doctors here are great!  We have been coming here for a few years and have never had an issue with the level of care or customer service.
Dr. Quant is awesome!
Excellent animal clinic experience. The staff were very kind and hospitable. Dr. Ferguson was very knowledgeable and wonderful with my dog. I will continue to bring my dog to this animal hospital.
Incredible!  Dr Ferguson saved our cat’s life.  She was so kind and understanding and made a very difficult process manageable.  The whole staff is kind and caring.

We've been bringing our animals here for about 30 yrs. I would not go anywhere else. They treat our animals like they were there's.I honestly can't say one negative comment. All the vets are outstanding, the reception staff is incredible!. They go out of their way to help you either over the phone or in the office. They're very caring! My animals mean to much to me to take them any where else!

Absolutely amazing. FLF took us in at the very last second, as new patients, to help my 10 month old puppy with her leg injury. As clients of Banfield for so many years and tired of feeling nickel and dimed at every turn, FLF was so refreshing to work with! They were up front with all potential costs and made us feel at ease.  They were SOOOO GREAT with baby Ruby, too!! They sat on the exam room floor and played with her while they were assessing. They were incredibly compassionate when they took her back for care/x-rays. I can't say enough good things about them. We will forever be with them!

All of the staff are friendly, helpful, and the office is efficient even when its super busy. Dr Val is amazing, loving, and truly loves her animals. She has helped us work through loss and then the welcoming of a new 4 legged. Thank you Dr Val and Team! Colleen and Bruce Hallberg, and our Goldens.
Dr Ferguson and the staff are always attentive and friendly!

Dr. Ferguson and her staff and all the vets are the best. Knowledgeable and caring. I cannot say enough about them. She has been taking care of me and my four legged family for over 25 years.  All of the vets are wonderful and caring as is the staff

An absolute amazing vet!  Our little pup Benny had double luxating patella surgery at Four Legged Friends and is doing amazing.  The doctors and technicians at FLF are second to none.  I absolutely love bringing our pup here and will be sad when he fully recovers, and not seeing them so much.  Highly recommend!

Dr. Ferguson and staff are amazing! Can't say enough great things about this clinic...one of the few left that are not corporate owned. They understand how much I love my pets and ALWAYS go above and beyond to make sure they have what they need. Attentive, compassionate, responsive, flexible, efficient, and comprehensive.
Doc val is the best that you for all you have done foe Fieby.
I have taken all my cats to Four Legged Friends and have always had a positive experience - from the techs to the vets, everyone has always been kind, helpful and knowledgable.

I took my loving girls Latte and Shelby here for YEARS. They are both now waiting for me at The Rainbow Bridge. Dr. Ferguson and Dr. Isom will always hold a special place in my heart, as will the technicians who knew and possibly remember me. I'm living in my hometown of Chicago now after living in Phoenix for 40 years. I'm getting ready to rescue a baby. I miss you all and can't name everybody; but you know who you are. I never forget THE BEST ones. Thank you all.
I love this place. Everyone is friendly and helpful and Dr Ferguson is the best.

I found FLF when I moved into the area. Since then, I have visited for dental and medical services for my 13yo Blue Heeler and I am now getting ready to add two more dogs to the family. I highly recommend FLF for their expertise and affordable services.
Dr Quant is the bomb, she is very knowledgeable and gentle  with our dogs. would recommend her to everyone but then again I wouldn't get her when I needed her.
Friendly, provides good explanations and alternative outcomes. Provides quick responses.
Great care for all of our pets.
The staff are so friendly and efficient! Dr Ferguson is caring and compassionate to my 17 year old dog and has helped us through several health crises.
Very kind, compassionate staff and doctors! They are especially good at helping you make the difficult decisions and they are considerate of your finances.  So glad I found them, they are the best!
I absolutely love EVERYONE HERE.  From the moment you enter and leave you are treated like family and so are your pets.

The staff and docs have ALWAYS been welcoming, courteous and seem to go out of their way to help! My dog has special needs that most vets will not take on. They didn't even hesitate when I told them he had megaesophagus!
Very professional and knowledgeable. My mastiff enjoys his annual trips to see Dr. Valerie and her team.
Dr. Ferguson and staff are amazing.  She is Four Legged Friends.  There is no other Vet like her.  She cares for your animals as if they are her own.  No one could replace her.

Auntie Jen and Dr Riddle was absolutely phenominal. They were both very professional but added in enough tlc for both my dog, Lily, and for me as a caretaker feeling a little defeated, perhaps because I felt like I as an owner should have been a little more diligent on certain aspects of her care. I did the best I could with the information I had, and both tech and Dr. gave me all the important facts, as well as researching medication prices and offering important information in regards to financial assistance for procedures that are a little above my income level right now. I don't know if any other Animal Hospital would go to the extent they did and I SOOO appreciate it. My dog is my family and I appreciate anyone who treats her like she were a part of their family. I'm impressed. Thank you so much Dr T Riddle and "Auntie"  Jen. You helped make a difficult task very manageable.
I've been with them since 1998... Best Care Anywhere
Very competent from front desk to techs  to Dr.s.  Feel in very good hands!

I'm so glad I found this place when I moved across the valley in 2020. So compassionate, helpful and friendly. So knowledgeable. Every single person. They treat my furry babies like they were their own.  I feel their pricing is comparable, but you can't put a price on compassion. They are super busy at almost all times but they will get you in.
The staff at Four Legged Friends are amazing. Fabulous doctors too.
I wouldn't take my dog anywhere else.  I trust them completely.
Dr. Ferguson and the entire staff at Four Legged Friends Animal Hosp are wonderful and caring people. I highly recommend them.
Dr Ferguson is the best

I've been bringing my dogs to Four Legged Friends Animal Hospital for over 20 years and am consistently impressed with the Vets and the amazing Staff!  I wish I could list each one by name but over the course of 20+ years I've pretty much had contact with every employee there and I can say that some of the staff that are there now were there when I first started taking my dogs to them.  Any business that can keep employees and patients for 20+ years has got to be good.  Dr. Ferguson & Dr. Riddle are both amazing veterinarians who take the time to listen to your concerns, answer questions and never make you feel rushed.  They've been taking care of my dogs from puppyhood to end of life and I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a neighborhood vet who puts your animals first.
They handled my very aggressive cat who was very sick beautifully. Very experienced! Am very grateful!

I have been taking my cat here for several years, they know her, and always take great care of her. Not sure KC is always happy when we head in there, but she seems to trust those caring for her, which says so much.  I’m very happy with the service, care, prices, and options they offer, and as long as KC needs them, I will continue to take her where I know she will get the best care.

I wouldn’t recommend this vet to anyone who actually cares about their pet. They killed my dog after RECOMMENDING that she, who is almost 12 years old, get 4 teeth extracted which ended up killing her due to complications from the surgery. She was completely fine and happy before the surgery. They will take your money by recommending treatments and medications for your dog that aren't even necessary. They just want your money.
They pay attention to my questions.  They give me how much it'll cost before they work on my pet(s)
The staff are incredible and you can tell they love what they do.
They are always so wonderful and helpful. Have been going there with all the dogs.
they seem to really care about dogs and are reasonably priced
Wonderful place. Caring, professional, thorough!
We have always had excellent service at Four Legged Friends.  Dr Ferguson is awesome as well as all the staff.
I consider it an honor and a privilege every time I get to spend a few minutes with Dr. Ferguson. She is so great with the animals and just all around amazing human being.

Front desk staff, technicians, and the doctors are wonderful. Compassionate, caring attitudes to both humans & animals. Most  importantly,  the doctors are excellent at diagnosing & treating your pet.
They are absolutely the best!
We drive from Globe.  Well worth the 5-6 hour round trip to get Dr. Ferguson.
Great place for your best friend

My elderly chihuahua with only one kidney needed dental work/teeth pulled and Dr. Bessemer did a great job.  He made it safely thru the dental surgery and anesthesia. He's all healed now and back to feeling well.

Had been so happy with this group, but now so much has changed.  We came in because our girl kitty was starting to spray everywhere in the house except her box. The only suggestion given was getting Feliway diffusers.  Got a second opinion elsewhere and found she had a cyst pressing on her bladder which obviously was causing her discomfort and inability to pee fully.  It was drained and the problem was quickly resolved and she's back to being the good cat box girl she always was. But also had differing opinions from 2 of the vets about another issue, and when I questioned and asked to talk to the second vet again before making a change based on second opinion, I was treated with a snippy attitude on the phone and no return call.  So sad that after 5 years and many visits with several animals we were treated like that.

The staff and vets here are remarkably sweet and helped my partner Alex and I immensely when our elderly cat, Yoda, needed treatment and eventually had to leave us for the big litter box in the sky. They made the process the best it possibly could’ve been given the circumstances and I am so grateful for that. Would definitely recommend.
Great service, follow up & excellence care.
Best animal hospital. They’ve been seeing all of my animals for the past 13 years. Love them all.
They always fit us in. Have been very respectful for each pet

Kato (our aussie border collie mix) and us love the staff at four legged friends.  Friendly, professional, and most importantly caring. The doctors lay out all the options so we can make an informed decision.
ALWAYS PROFESIONAL  AND CARING...
Best staff ever!
Doctor Ferguson and her staff are the very best.  She has been my vet for decades.
Staff is wonderful, so glad Dr. Quant is still available occasionally!🤩 …
We take all of our pets, including Frezno here. Professional and friendly place that we highly recommend.
Dr. Ferguson is the best! She is empathetic, knowledgeable and straight forward. She is thoughtful when discussing the pets she is working with. The front desk ladies are helpful and very friendly.
Dr Quandt was wonderful with my not so friendly dog. Estimate for treatment was reasonable.
I've been going to four-legged friends for over 20 years, the most friendly staff and knowledgeable doctors I've ever had to deal with. I love them

I met Dr Ferguson almost 30 years ago.  She's the best.

I wouldn’t recommend this vet to anyone who actually cares about their pet.
My dog, Lucky, went in for a routine teeth cleaning and somehow ended up in a nightmare. He was diagnosed with Stage 2 Kidney Failure, yet they didn’t suggest hospitalization, a specialist, or anything serious—just a kidney diet that made his condition way worse. That diet triggered pancreatitis and gallbladder issues, sending him downhill fast.
When he got even sicker, they STILL didn’t take action. We had to rush him to emergency care, where every vet we saw was shocked that he hadn’t already been admitted. Because of their negligence, my family endured extreme stress, heartbreak, and financial strain just to save Lucky’s life.
This clinic completely failed us. They ignored obvious warning signs and dismissed serious concerns, putting Lucky through unnecessary suffering. If you value your pet’s health, find a more competent vet.
